Published online:
    September 3, 2026

Geographic focus:
    India, with secondary focus on US markets and global macro context

Temporal focus:
    T1. Historical report [NO]
    T2. Forward-looking reporting short-term risks (next few weeks/months) [YES]

Synopsis:
    The Indian rupee hit a two-month high driven by $136.4B in inflows boosting RBI reserves to record levels. Offsetting tailwinds include rising crude oil prices from renewed US-Iran conflict and a stronger dollar supported by elevated Fed rate hike expectations. The RBI's expanding forward book limits rupee upside despite the reserve cushion.
